lessons_used: sign_in/hint changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+5.8% after noise correction).
choose_path/copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption/redesign, choose_path/layout, finish/notification, home/new_screen, and sign_in/reorder as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all Round 1 tests and for major redesigns.
Predictions were too low for the first sign_in/hint test, where measured results (+11.5%) significantly exceeded the predicted gain (+3.0%).

candidates.title: Companion Selection Grid Redesign with Filter Tags
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection screen into a grid layout with visual choice cards to streamline pet selection.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low completion rate (65.9%) and high mean duration (1017s), showing users struggle during companion selection.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign-In Session Persistence Reassurance Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit session persistence hint clarifying that pet data and account state are automatically saved across sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing back in, and sign-in hints previously yielded strong conversion gains.

sign_in.hint: Your progress and pet profile are securely bound to this sign-in method and restored automatically.

guard.reason: Valid addition of sign-in hint explaining session persistence.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints have strong empirical support (+5.8% across 2 winning tests) and 8 support tickets directly request session reassurance.

candidates.title: Real-Time Companion Generation Preview Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated waiting preview screen before system setup displaying interactive visual progress while rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting step has an exceptionally long mean time (2336s), leading to user drop-off during background generation.

new_waiting_preview.headline: Creating Your Desktop Companion
new_waiting_preview.body: Your pet is being prepared in the background. Setup will conclude momentarily.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new waiting preview screen within onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Home step has extreme mean wait time, but adding new preview screens previously reduced conversion (-0.9%) and has high build cost.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Screen Immediately After Welcome Story
candidates.change: Move sign-in directly after the story welcome screen to establish account persistence before path selection.
candidates.why: Signing in early ensures user account identity is locked before creation choices, addressing account reset support complaints.

guard.reason: sign_in may move later, not before choose_path

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Flow
candidates.change: Transform home_intro into a structured onboarding checklist flow showing key desktop controls and tray menu actions.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop

components.text: Learn tray controls, summon shortcut, and pet interactions

guard.reason: Valid home intro checklist redesign within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 35.2% of users and support emails confirm post-onboarding confusion, but complex new flows carry high implementation cost and overprediction risk.

candidates.title: Background Processing Status and Estimate
candidates.change: Add explicit estimated completion time copy and status indicators to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users abandon during home step due to high mean wait time (2336s) without clear indication of background status.

waiting.headline: Finalizing Companion Setup
waiting.body: Estimated setup time: under 2 minutes. Feel free to minimize this window while we finish.

guard.reason: Valid wait time estimate during a real waiting process.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the 2336s mean wait time at home step with clear status copy is safer and lower cost than introducing a full new screen.

candidates.title: Official Adoption Certificate Stamp Incentive
candidates.change: Display an official digital adoption badge on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet creation.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (65.9%); providing a sense of milestone accomplishment encourages proceeding.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Companion Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Congratulations! Your adoption certificate has been registered.

guard.reason: Valid adoption certificate badge addition retaining official stamp job.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high drop-off (34.1%), and adding a badge incentive on an existing screen is low-to-moderate effort.

candidates.title: Desktop System Tray Discovery Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompts on completion explaining how to summon or manage the pet from system tray.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails noted pets disappearing or users unable to locate companion controls on first desktop launch.

home_intro.hint: Your companion is active on your desktop. Access controls anytime via the system tray icon.

guard.reason: Valid notification configuration added to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails regarding lost desktop pets, though previous notification test showed a very modest lift (+0.2%).

candidates.title: Creation Speed & Path Clarity Headline Update
candidates.change: Revise path selection headline and body copy to clearly distinguish instant adoption from custom creation.
candidates.why: Choose path has a 23.8% drop-off rate and 514s mean time, showing user hesitation between options.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Adopt
choose_path.body: Select an instant ready companion or create a custom pet from your own photos.

candidates.title: Photo Clarity & Lighting Hint on Upload
candidates.change: Add visual photo quality guidance hint to the photo upload screen explaining optimal image conditions.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failures or distorted visual pet models after photo upload.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for accurate 3D companion generation.

lessons_next: adoption/redesign changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+8.7% average after noise correction).
sign_in/hint changes are helpful, with 2 winning tests agreeing on positive impact (+4.2% average after noise correction).
choose_path/copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home/new_screen changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path/layout, finish/new_flow, finish/notification, and sign_in/reorder as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high in Round 1, but significantly underestimated major winners in sign_in/hint (+11.5% vs +3.0% predicted) and adoption/redesign (+22.4% vs +3.3% predicted).
